report.explanation: All four services show error_rate 0.001 and p95 72ms, which does not corroborate the alert's error-rate and latency claim. Order shows elevated retained memory (300MB, retained_after_gc) but no memory-retention history, so a leak cannot be established. No deployment facts or alert-aligned facts exist. Insufficient evidence for any bounded root cause; handoff required.
missing_evidence: Time-series memory-retention history for order to distinguish a leak from a stable baseline
Alert-aligned telemetry showing actual error-rate and latency degradation
Deployment records for the incident window
Dependency timeout and db pool metrics over a longer window
